The first save feels good: the title, description, site, favicon, and time make the MDN link easy to recognize. The calm layout, pinned save box, and newest-first order all feel right, and a single address field is exactly the quick-saving experience I pictured.

I did find one important problem: saving the same address again created a second identical entry. I don’t want duplicates. It should recognize that the link already exists and take me to that existing entry so I can review or edit it.

When tags and read-later status are added, I’d also like those visible on each entry. Otherwise, this is the right basic presentation.
